co-pair fallback layouts_flatco.cpp: skip windows with >400 residual vertices; count exact distinct co-occurring pairs; reject once pairs.size()>100000000. The error text mentions an 8GiB workspace estimate; this is NOT a measured peak RSS and not a logged exact byte value.
v7 flat-table preflight: bound=min(enumerated_pairs, choose(residual_points,2),100000001); estimated bytes=context capacities + per-window/point capacities + capacity_for(bound)*(sizeof(uint64_t)+sizeof(uint32_t)) + bound*sizeof(tuple<int,int,int>) + 1GiB. If >8GiB, fallback to original map; no truncation. Actual per-condition vector capacities were not logged, so do not invent a numeric byte estimate.
D/tail-co timings: original d_sec includes lc.layout + lc.metrics; a D-greedy row also includes K ordering inside layout. Separate D-greedy/tail-co seconds are unavailable from existing logs. No rerun or inferred subtraction is used.
A1 residual nnz adds one diagonal per residual row; membership D uses fixed A0 degree.
